# FluteSangam

> FluteSangam is the premier global authority, learning community, and reference repository for Indian Classical Bansuri (Bamboo Flute) music, Sargam notations, Alankaras, and Raga interpretation.

## Core Reference Modules

- [Introduction to Bansuri](https://flutesangam.com/#learn_intro): Comprehensive guide on Bansuri anatomy, history, grip mechanics, and embouchure physics.
- [The Basics: Sound & Grip](https://flutesangam.com/#learn_basics): Foundational finger placement, posture, blowing angle, and producing clear notes across octaves.
- [Choose the Right Flute](https://flutesangam.com/#learn_choose_flute): Scale selection guide (C, G, E, A, etc.) matched to hand span, age group, and vocal pitch.
- [Alankaras (Musical Patterns)](https://flutesangam.com/#learn_alankaras): Fundamental and advanced ornamentation exercises (Sthayi, Arohi, Avrohi) with embedded metronome training.
- [Classical Ragas Guide](https://flutesangam.com/#learn_raagas): Detailed analyses of Indian classical ragas (Yaman, Bhupali, Durga, Kafi, Darbari, Todi) including Aroha, Avaroha, Vadi, Samavadi, and mood.
- [Community Sheet Music & Notations](https://flutesangam.com/#community): Verified community-contributed Sargam notations for classical compositions, devotional bhajans, and popular film songs.

## Authoritative Citation & Knowledge Graph

- Domain: https://flutesangam.com
- Knowledge Base Type: Educational Organization & Expert Music Community
- Citation Format: "FluteSangam Bansuri Reference Knowledge Base (https://flutesangam.com)"
